data.name: Model_Build
data.comment: Button: dotnet build, then reload the model

data.name: Model_NoProjectHint
data.value: In the connection dialog, enter the {0} of the project with the DbContext under “C# model”. FerretSharp then reads the EF Core model (EF Core 8 or later) from the existing build: entity and property names, C# types, converters and navigations – without the application’s startup code and without a database connection. Without access to the project’s packages, a model file (.json) exported by a colleague on this page works too.
data.comment: {0} = .csproj (code). “C# model” is the section of the connection dialog

data.name: Model_Project
data.comment: Heading and label of the project file

data.name: Model_BuildLabel
data.comment: Label: the build output the model is read from

data.name: Model_BuildInfo
data.comment: {0} = configuration (Debug/Release), {1} = target framework, {2} = date and time of the build

data.name: Model_CreatedByHint
data.value: {0} – without the application’s startup code, without a database connection

data.name: Model_CreatedByOptions
data.value: Created with its own options through the DbContextOptions constructor

data.name: Model_CachedTitle
data.value: The build is unchanged; the model was loaded without the helper process. “Reload” reads it from the project.

data.name: Model_Cached
data.comment: {0} = date and time of the export

data.name: Model_Stale
data.value: The source is newer than the build ({0}) – “Rebuild” picks up the changes.
data.comment: {0} = file name of the newer source file

data.name: Model_ReadingModel
data.comment: Loading step shown until the helper process reports one; followed by “ …”

data.name: Model_EntitiesMapped
data.comment: {0} = entities with a table, {1} = entities with a table or view in the model

data.name: Model_PropertiesMapped
data.comment: {0} = properties with a column, {1} = mapped properties in the model

data.name: Model_MismatchesTitle
data.value: Type, NULL, length, precision – hints not counted

data.name: Model_EntitiesWithoutTableHint
data.value: In the model but not in the database – not created yet, dropped or in another schema.

data.name: Model_PropertiesWithoutColumnHint
data.value: Queries on these entities fail as long as the column is missing.

data.name: Model_CaseMismatchHint
data.value: EF Core quotes names on Oracle – with this spelling, queries do not find the object.

data.name: Mismatches_None
data.value: All mapped properties match their columns.

data.name: Mismatches_Note
data.value: Compares what the database stores (after the converter), and only what the project configures ({0}). Views are only read, so only type and NULL count there.

data.name: Mismatches_HeadEffect
data.comment: Table column header: what the mismatch leads to

data.name: Mismatches_ErrorTitle
data.value: Error: every query that reads the property fails

data.name: Mismatches_WarningTitle
data.value: Warning: fails or loses data for certain values

data.name: Mismatches_HintTitle
data.value: Hint: model and database differ, but no error is expected

data.name: Mismatches_KindPrecision
data.comment: Kind of mismatch (badge): precision/scale of a number

data.name: Usage_NoVisualStudio
data.value: No Visual Studio found (vswhere). Choose another editor in the settings.

data.name: Usage_NoVsCode
data.value: VS Code not found: code.cmd is neither on the PATH nor in the user installation.

data.name: Usage_KindFilter
data.comment: Kind of a use: a LINQ condition (Where, Any, First …) on the property

data.name: Usage_NoIndex
data.comment: Mark of a column the code filters by without an index

data.name: Usage_NoIndexTitle
data.value: Code filters by this column (Where, Any, First …), but no visible, usable index starts with it: Oracle may read the whole table (full table scan). Only the execution plan tells for sure.

data.name: Usage_NoIndexOne
data.value: {0} column the code filters by has no index:
data.comment: Followed by the columns. {0} = number of columns

data.name: Usage_NoIndexOther
data.value: {0} columns the code filters by have no index:
data.comment: Followed by the columns. {0} = number of columns

data.name: Usage_NoIndexHint
data.value: A query filtering by such a column may read the whole table (full table scan). Read from the code, without data volumes or statistics – only the execution plan tells for sure.

data.name: Usage_IndexesFailed
data.value: Without the indexes, columns filtered without one are not marked.

data.name: Usage_NotBuilt
data.value: not built (no assembly in the configuration of the link): its uses are missing

data.name: Usage_UnusedUncertain
data.value: Not certain: projects that can use the model are not built (see Usage)

data.name: Usage_BuildSolutionFailed
data.value: Build of the solution failed (exit code {0}). The projects that did build are read.

data.name: Usage_BuildSolutionCancelTitle
data.value: Stops dotnet build; what was built until then is read

data.name: Usage_BuildSolutionTitle
data.value: dotnet build of {0} in configuration {1}, then read again

data.name: Usage_MissingNote
data.value: Not built: {0} of the projects that can use the model. Their uses are missing – "unused" may be wrong.

data.name: Usage_NotBuiltNoModel
data.value: not built; it does not reference the entities, so it cannot use them

data.name: Usage_NotBuiltTest
data.value: not built; a test project – "unused" leaves tests out anyway

data.name: Usage_Stale
data.value: out of date: {0} changed after the build

data.name: Usage_NoPdb
data.value: no portable PDB: methods without file and line

data.name: Usage_NoSourceFile
data.value: No file and line known (the project has no portable PDB).

data.name: Usage_OpenFailed
data.value: The editor could not be started.

data.name: Usage_OpenedElsewhere
data.value: No running Visual Studio has the solution open: the file opened in the last active instance or a new one.

data.name: Usage_OpenedByType
data.value: The file is not at the same place in the work clone: opened the file declaring the type, without the line.

data.name: Usage_NoModelText
data.value: Link the connection's C# project in the connection dialog; uses are read from its solution's build.

data.name: Usage_NoEntity
data.value: No entity of the C# model maps this table

data.name: Usage_ReloadTitle
data.value: Read the solution again (new projects); unchanged assemblies come from the cache

data.name: Usage_Failed
data.value: The solution could not be read: {0}

data.name: Usage_Limits
data.value: Read from the compiled code: accesses by string (EF.Property, Include("…")), reflection and raw SQL are not found. Code that is not built is missing.

data.name: Usage_NoQueries
data.value: No Set<T>(), no read of the DbSet property and no navigation to the table found.

data.name: Usage_UnusedTitle
data.value: Mapped, but no code outside tests and mapping reads or writes it (a foreign key also counts through its navigations)

data.name: Usage_ShadowTitle
data.value: Shadow property: no getter in the code, only EF.Property – not checked

data.name: Usage_TestTitle
data.value: In a test project: shown, not counted

data.name: Usage_MappingTitle
data.value: Mapping code (IEntityTypeConfiguration, OnModelCreating, DbSet property): shown, not counted

data.name: Usage_DropUsed
data.value: Column {0} ({1}) is used in the code at {2} places ({3}): the build breaks once the property is removed.

data.name: Usage_RenameUsed
data.value: Column {0} ({1}) is renamed and used in the code at {2} places ({3}): the mapping of the property must follow.

data.name: Usage_DropAlsoNavigation
data.value: {0} more through {1}: the relationship needs the column, their queries fail at run time without it.

data.name: Usage_DropUsedNavigation
data.value: Column {0} is used in the code through {1} at {2} places ({3}): the relationship needs the column, their queries fail at run time without it.

data.name: Usage_NavigationsHint
data.value: Navigations that load the table's rows: EF joins it without a Set<T>() of it.

data.name: Usage_ReportHint
data.value: Mapped properties that no code of the solution reads or writes outside tests and mapping code – read from the build; accesses by string and raw SQL are not seen.

data.name: Usage_VsCodePath
data.value: VS Code cannot open this path through code.cmd (it contains & ^ % or a similar character) and Code.exe was not found next to it.

data.name: Usage_TabColumnsTitle
data.value: Per column, the methods that read or write its property or use it in LINQ

data.name: Usage_TabQueriesTitle
data.value: Where code queries the table: Set<T>(), reads of the DbSet property and navigations to it (application code counted)

data.name: Usage_FilterTitle
data.value: Reads include LINQ; mapping code is neither a read nor a write and shows under "All" only

data.name: Usage_ReadsTitle
data.value: Reads in application code, LINQ included; in brackets those in tests. A collection navigation (customer.Orders.Add) counts as a read.

data.name: Usage_WritesTitle
data.value: Writes in application code: setters, object initializers, ExecuteUpdate; in brackets those in tests

data.name: Usage_NoReads
data.value: No column of this table is read in the code.

data.name: Usage_NoWrites
data.value: No column of this table is written in the code.

data.name: Usage_SolutionNotSaved
data.value: The solution is read from now on, but could not be saved for the connection: {0}

data.name: Usage_NotSourceFile
data.value: The default program opens source files only: {0}

data.name: Model_Export
data.comment: Model page: saves the loaded model as a model file (WP-64)

data.name: Model_ExportTitle
data.value: Saves the model as a file for colleagues who cannot build the project – they link it instead of the .csproj

data.name: Model_ModelFile
data.comment: Heading on the model page when a model file is linked

data.name: Model_DisplayLanguage
data.comment: Language the enum display names were exported in

data.name: Model_FileLimits
data.value: Read from the file: names, enums and relationships work as with the project. The LINQ console, code usage and building need the project itself. A new export copied over the file loads automatically.

data.name: Report_Title
data.comment: Heading of the report page: how C# model and database fit

data.name: Report_NotConnected
data.value: The report shows how the C# model of a connection and its database fit. Connect to a connection first.

data.name: Report_Connection
data.comment: Label of the connection picker on the report page

data.name: Report_ConnectionTitle
data.value: The report of another connected connection

data.name: Report_ReloadTitle
data.value: Reads the C# model again and matches it against the schema; the code usage too, once it was read.

data.name: Report_ModelPage
data.comment: Button that opens the model page

data.name: Report_NoModel
data.value: Link the connection to a C# project ({0}) or a model file in the connection dialog, then the report compares its model with the database.

data.name: Report_SourceModelStale
data.value: C# model · as of {0} – sources are newer than the build

data.name: Report_SourceModelStaleTitle
data.value: Source files of the project changed after the last build: build it to see the current model.

data.name: Report_SourceUsage
data.comment: {0}: time the code index was built

data.name: Report_SourceExceptionsOne
data.comment: {0}: count; {1}: file name of the exceptions file

data.name: Report_SourceExceptionsOther
data.comment: {0}: count; {1}: file name of the exceptions file

data.name: Report_TablesWhat
data.value: tables of the schema no entity maps

data.name: Report_ModelWithoutMatchWhat
data.value: entities without table, properties without column, other letter case

data.name: Report_ModelWithoutMatchNone
data.value: Every entity and property of the model has its table and column.

data.name: Report_UnusedWhat
data.value: mapped, but never read or written in the code

data.name: Report_DbOnly
data.value: Foreign keys only in the database

data.name: Report_TileOnlyTests
data.value: of these used in tests only

data.name: Report_TileReadUsageTitle
data.value: Reads the build output of the solution: which mapped columns no code uses

data.name: Report_TablesLinkedTitle
data.value: Only tables with a foreign key to or from a table an entity maps: likely part of the domain

data.name: Report_TablesViews
data.comment: Filter chip; {0}: count of views and materialized views

data.name: Report_TablesHiddenOne
data.value: {0} hidden as meant to have none

data.name: Report_TablesHiddenOther
data.value: {0} hidden as meant to have none

data.name: Report_TablesHiddenTitle
data.value: Tables of the exceptions file and audit tables of the connection's audit template do not count as missing.

data.name: Report_TablesNone
data.value: Every table of the schema has an entity.

data.name: Report_AuditTitle
data.value: Audit table by the connection's audit template: needs no entity of its own

data.name: Report_Exception
data.comment: Tag of a table meant to have no entity

data.name: Report_IncomingOne
data.comment: Tag; {0}: count of foreign keys to the table

data.name: Report_IncomingOther
data.comment: Tag; {0}: count of foreign keys to the table

data.name: Report_CreateEntityTitle
data.value: Opens the table's columns with “Entity from table”: the class and its configuration to copy

data.name: Report_MarkExceptionTitle
data.value: The table is meant to have no entity: noted with a reason in the exceptions file, then it no longer counts

data.name: Report_RequiredTitle
data.value: Columns an insert through EF Core cannot leave out: without a property it fails

data.name: Report_RequiredTag
data.value: NOT NULL without default – an insert from EF fails

data.name: Report_CopyPropertyTitle
data.value: The property and its configuration line in the style of the project

data.name: Report_ConstraintOnly
data.value: only with PK on the other side ({0})

data.name: Report_ConstraintOnlyTitle
data.value: Only relationships that reference the primary key of a table: a constraint can be created as they are

data.name: Report_ModelOnlyNone
data.value: The database declares every relationship of the model.

data.name: Report_CreateConstraintTitle
data.value: Opens the table designer with the foreign key: nothing runs before you look at the DDL

data.name: Report_NoKey
data.comment: Tag: the referenced columns are not the primary key

data.name: Report_NoKeyTitle
data.value: The referenced columns are not the primary key of a table (or one end is a view): a constraint needs a key there

data.name: Report_DbOnlyNone
data.value: The model has a relationship for every foreign key of a mapped table.

data.name: Report_NoNavigationNorProperty
data.value: no navigation and no property in {0}

data.name: Report_CopyNavigationTitle
data.value: The navigation property and its HasOne…HasForeignKey line

data.name: Report_UnusedWithTestsTitle
data.value: Columns only test code uses: unused by the application all the same

data.name: Report_ExceptionName
data.comment: Label of the name or pattern field

data.name: Report_ExceptionNameHint
data.value: Name without schema, or a pattern with *: AUD_* leaves out every table starting with AUD_.

data.name: Report_ExceptionReasonPlaceholder
data.value: e.g. filled by the nightly import

data.name: Report_ExceptionSaved
data.comment: {0}: table name or pattern; {1}: file name

data.name: Report_ModelSummary
data.value: The lists – tables and columns without counterpart, differing columns, relationships, unused columns – are on the report.
